北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天但体感热，湿度也大，别忘了多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast but feels hot with high humidity. Remember to stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光灿烂，气温高风大，记得防晒补水。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny, hot, and breezy. Don't forget sunscreen and plenty of water.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感温度高，注意防暑降温，小心热浪。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels very hot. Take care to prevent heatstroke and cool down.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州中雨降温风大，出门记得带雨具，注意保暖。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has moderate rain and strong winds. Grab your umbrella and stay warm!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳中雨湿气重，体感凉爽，出门雨具不能少。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen sees moderate rain and high humidity. It feels cool, but don't forget your umbrella.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州天气炎热，体感高，湿度低，多补水哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is hot and feels even hotter with low humidity. Please drink plenty of water.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感极热，防暑降温是关键，注意身体。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels extremely hot. Preventing heatstroke is key, please take care of yourself.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都气温高且干燥，体感炎热，请多喝水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is hot and dry, feeling very warm. Remember to drink plenty of water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感温度高，注意防暑降温，避免中暑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels very hot. Be sure to prevent heatstroke and keep cool.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感稍热，记得多喝水，注意防晒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels slightly warm. Remember to hydrate and protect from the sun.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热，体感极高且干燥，一定要多补水防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny, extremely hot, and dry! Stay hydrated to beat the heat.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云体感舒适，风力稍大，出行注意。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and comfortable, with a noticeable breeze. Mind your steps outdoors.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云体感较热，湿度大，请注意补水哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy and feels quite warm with high humidity. Please hydrate!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感舒适，微风轻拂，享受凉爽。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and comfortable, with a gentle breeze. Enjoy the pleasant weather.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感舒适，风力较大，湿度高。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and comfortable, with noticeable wind and high humidity.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感闷热，湿度大，多喝水保健康。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy and feels muggy with high humidity. Drink water for your health.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感微热，湿度适中，出行愉快。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy and feels mildly warm with moderate humidity. Enjoy your day!
